fig_data_source_timeline.n_definition: daytime forecast rows for GFS, unique UTC hours for truth sources

fig_cloud_error_ghi_error_hexbin.n_definition: daytime site×valid-hour×lead rows with both GFS and ERA5 cloud values; ERA5 is supplementary reference

fig_feature_distribution_hexbin.n_definition: daytime site×valid-hour×lead rows with finite formal forecast features

fig_value_ladder.n_definition: 9,564 identical Nanjing site×target-hour×lead outer-score rows per model

fig_cpu_lead_performance.n_definition: 3,188 identical outer-score site×target-hour rows per model per lead

fig_cpu_improvement_vs_raw.n_definition: five chronological outer-fold contrasts per model; no confidence interval claimed

fig_tuning_candidates.n_definition: 270 inner trial scores = 3 models × 5 outer prefixes × 6 candidates × 3 inner folds
fig_tuning_candidates.statistic: unweighted mean of 15 inner-fold mean pinball values per candidate; gray lines are per-outer three-fold means

fig_quantile_case.n_definition: 12 observed D+1 daylight hours on selected local day
fig_quantile_case.case_selection_rule: eligible days >=8 observed D+1 hours; closest daily raw-GFS RMSE to median, earlier date breaks tie

fig_coverage_reliability.n_definition: observed Nanjing test site×target-hour×lead rows per model; repeated leads are correlated

fig_coverage_width.n_definition: observed Nanjing test site×target-hour×lead rows per model and interval

fig_weather_conditional_coverage.n_definition: observed test rows per lead and forecast-cloud stratum; model counts match

fig_cpu_overall_pinball.n_definition: 9,564 identical outer-score rows per model; five fold dots and pooled diamond
fig_cpu_overall_pinball.statistic: mean of seven pinball losses; raw quantile crossing rate shown, not repaired

fig_shap_beeswarm.n_definition: 768 equal-stride outer-5 development forecasts; no final-test rows
fig_shap_beeswarm.caution: SHAP explains one frozen fitted model; it does not select features or establish causality

fig_key_feature_hexbin.n_definition: observed development outer-score site×target-hour×lead rows across five folds
fig_key_feature_hexbin.caution: feature-residual association is not group ablation or causal contribution

fig_group_ablation.n_definition: 15 inner scoring blocks = 5 nested outer training prefixes × 3 inner folds; outer dots are not independent sites
fig_group_ablation.statistic: unweighted mean loss difference; positive means disruption/removal worsened pinball; no confidence interval claimed
fig_group_ablation.limitation: Fixed full-model candidate; spatial-static constant at one site; Base+cloud/kt controls still pending

fig_group_permutation.n_definition: 15 inner scoring blocks = 5 nested outer training prefixes × 3 inner folds; outer dots are not independent sites
fig_group_permutation.statistic: unweighted mean loss difference; positive means disruption/removal worsened pinball; no confidence interval claimed
fig_group_permutation.limitation: Three deterministic repeats; correlated features share effects; not causal importance
